import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dP_dt

def mk(p,f):
    b=p[0]
    return np.c_[t*np.sin(b*P),P,1/P,f]
out=[]
for k,f in fs.items():
    def r(p):
        A=mk(p,f); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]; return y-A@c
    best=None
    for b0 in [0.5,0.6,0.7]:
        s=least_squares(r,[b0])
        if best is None or s.cost<best.cost: best=s
    out.append((np.mean(r(best.x)**2)/np.var(y),k,best.x[0]))
out.sort()
for o in out: print(o)
